title: EcoBalance
description: A hardcore plugin where nature fights back! Cut trees to trigger storms and spirits, or plant saplings to get rewards.
body:
## 🌿 EcoBalance - Nature Strikes Back!

Attention: This plugin 1.0-1.1 supports the Russian language.

EcoBalance is an atmospheric, hardcore Minecraft survival plugin that forces players to respect the environment. If you destroy the forest without replanting, the world itself will turn against you!

### 🔥 Features:
* **🌲 Forest Anger Meter:** Every log you break increases the forest's wrath (tracked per player). If you reach 64 broken logs without replanting, you face **Instant Death**!
* **⚡ Severe Thunderstorms:** Breaking too many trees triggers dark, heavy storms. Watch out — real lethal lightning will strike right at your feet!
* **🪓 Tool Resistance:** Angry trees harden their bark. Your axes will mine slower and lose durability faster with every strike.
* **👥 Hordes of Forest Spirits:** Nature will summon a strike of visual lightning and unleash a pack of 3 invisible, extremely fast, and venomous Forest Spirits right behind your back!
* **🌱 Environmental Redemption & Blessing:** Placing saplings lowers the forest's anger and clears the weather with an epic thunderclap effect. Peaceful players who plant trees with 0 anger have a 10% chance to receive an Apple as a gift from nature!
* **⚙️ Fully Configurable:** Comes with an automatic `config.yml` file where server owners can customize broken log limits, drop chances, and custom chat messages.

### 🛠️ Installation:
1. Drop `EcoBalance-1.0.jar` into your server's `plugins` folder.
2. Restart or reload your server.
3. Enjoy the hardcore mechanics!
